name: Story of Seasons: Your Wonderful Life
summary:
Get away to your own slow-paced farming life.

Wake up every morning and tend to the fields. Care for your cows and sheep, ship out the day’s crops, and head into town.

Use your spare time fishing or mining, check the requests board in the town square, or just get to know the local residents.

And along the way, meet that special someone to spend the rest of your days with in Forgotten Valley.
